files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)

files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)

files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)
files.description: Synthetic 24-patch chart (original values, not a commercial chart): 6 x 4 patches of 64 px with a 4 px 18% grey border; patch values stated in BT.709-primary linear light and encoded with the sRGB transfer.

files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)
files.description: Twelve skin-tone patches (4 x 3, 64 px) spanning hue 14-32 degrees, HSV saturation 0.2-0.58 and value 0.22-0.95, in encoded sRGB.

files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)
files.description: Narrow neutral gradient from code 76.5 to 114.75 (encoded 0.30-0.45): rows 0-31 rounded only, rows 32-63 plus deterministic triangular noise of +-2 codes (integer hash). For banding checks after stretching.

files.format: PNG RGBA 8-bit, no color chunks (read as encoded sRGB)
files.description: Straight-alpha patches: four 16-row bands (white, orange, green, blue) whose alpha is the column x (0-255). For premultiplied-alpha handling.

files.format: H.264 yuv420p, BT.709 primaries/transfer/matrix, limited range, 24 fps, libx264 -threads 1 -crf 18, bitexact
files.description: A saturated orange disc (radius 36 px, encoded sRGB 0.86/0.33/0.12, 1 px anti-aliased edge) crossing a muted textured background (encoded 0.42/0.45/0.36 plus 0.06 sin(x/23 + 0.05 f) sin(y/17), plus +-5 code triangular integer-hash noise per frame). Encoded from exact RGB frames, so codec error is the only difference from the stated picture.

values.trajectory: centre(f) = (60 + 11 f, 150 + 2 f + 30 sin(2 pi f / 48)) px, pixel centres at x + 0.5
